from src.sink_audit import audit


def test_request_driven_sink_is_flagged():
    code = [
        "def handler(req):",
        "    expr = req.args['expr']",
        "    eval(expr)",
    ]
    assert audit(code) == [2]


def test_static_sink_is_not_flagged():
    code = [
        "def run():",
        "    eval('1 + 1')",
    ]
    assert audit(code) == []

+"""Audit helper: flag dangerous sinks that may receive request data."""
+
+WINDOW = 3
+
+SINKS = ("eval(", "os.system", "subprocess.")
+
+
+def audit(lines):
+    """Return indexes of sink lines with request input nearby."""
+    flagged = []
+    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
+        if not any(sink in line for sink in SINKS):
+            continue
+        window = lines[max(0, index - WINDOW):index + WINDOW + 1]
+        if any("request" in other or "req." in other for other in window):
+            flagged.append(index)
+    return flagged
